summary: Regression PASS. Multi-account isolation fix verified end-to-end via UI: after selecting a second account (TEST_2ND) on Home, Journal and Discipline now use the persisted selection (apextrade_account) — trade and note created for TEST_2ND do NOT appear on Cuenta principal, and switching back to TEST_2ND shows the data again. Backend regression pytest suite (2/2) passes. 2-loss rule card is rendered on Home and Discipline.

integration_issues.issue: settings.tsx still initializes local edit target with list[0] (getAccounts()[0]) instead of getSelectedAccount(list). Non-blocking for the reviewed regression (user can tap any account in the list), but inconsistent with Home/Journal/Discipline/Assistant which now honor the persisted apextrade_account. Reference: /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx:24.

action_items: Optional: align settings.tsx initial `selected` account with getSelectedAccount(list) so the edit form defaults to the same account the user picked on Home. Currently list[0] is loaded first (Cuenta principal); the user must tap the desired account to edit its metas.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in /app/frontend/src/api.ts:getSelectedAccount is correctly awaited on load and on useFocusEffect in Home, Journal, Discipline and Assistant.
Backend enforces account ownership per user via owned_account() on every trade/note/dashboard/notes/reports endpoint — no cross-user leakage risk.
Backend /api/dashboard consecutive_losses loop iterates trades sorted by entry_date desc; behavior consistent with 2-loss stop rule.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executed isolation flows (login → create 2nd account → switch chip → journal trade → discipline note → switch back to Cuenta principal → verify no leak → switch back to TEST_2ND → verify data intact)

seed_data_creation: All test data cleaned up. Two stray TEST_2ND accounts (from mid-run retries) and one leaked note were removed via API. Final account list: Cuenta principal, TEST UI Account (from iter2).
context_for_next_testing_agent: QA login: qa.apextrade@example.com / ApexTrade123. Preview URL: https://trader-daily-tracker.preview.emergentagent.com. NOTE: mcp_browser_automation opens a fresh browser context per invocation, so AsyncStorage (IndexedDB) does NOT persist between separate script runs — write the entire isolation flow in ONE script or the persisted account key will be lost.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 2 root cause: Home persisted apextrade_account into AsyncStorage but Journal/Discipline/Assistant used getAccounts()[0], sending API calls with the wrong account_id. Fix: getSelectedAccount(accounts) helper in /app/frontend/src/api.ts reads the persisted key and is now awaited in Home, Journal, Discipline and Assistant on focus. Verified fixed in iteration 3.
